All original solid surfaces stay fully opaque. Keep full painterly detail and tool output resolution. One asset, no comparison board, new label, text or watermark.

Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual tilted photo rectangle, frame rim and overlapping note intact.
